title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1550 State Road S-38-211 in Orangeburg, South Carolina, as the "J.I. Washington Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1550 State Road S-38-211 in Orangeburg, South Carolina, as the J.I. Washington Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Names a Postal Service facility in Orangeburg, South Carolina, the J.I. Washington Post Office Building.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 1550 State Road S-38-211 in Orangeburg, South Carolina. The building will be called the J.I. Washington Post Office Building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
